title: Tractor Supply Co (TSCO) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Crisis positioning, gold exposure and rural-retail value.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.claim: Correction speed is historically unprecedented
claims.reason: The distinction between a selloff from an all-time high and any fast selloff is explicit. Verification needs the full 90-year daily history, not only 2020 prices.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.
claims.next_check: Reproduce first 10% closing drawdown from each prior all-time high across both indices.

claims.claim: Defensive selling reflects margin-call liquidation
claims.reason: Cross-asset selling is consistent with forced deleveraging, but causation needs position, margin or fund-flow evidence. The 2008 analogy does not prove the 2020 motive.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Compare dated margin requirements, investor outflows and liquidity spreads during the specified late-February sessions.

claims.claim: Treasuries preserve crisis purchasing capacity
claims.reason: During the selloff week immediately before publication, short-, intermediate- and long-Treasury proxies gained 0.82%, 2.63% and 4.91%, while SPY fell 11.16%. This independently supports preserved purchasing capacity in that window. It does not establish positive long-run real returns or prove the actual duration allocation.
claims.direction_assessment: See independently checked outcomes and qualifications in reason.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

claims.claim: Lower prices do not guarantee cheap valuations
claims.reason: A stock can fall while expected cash flows fall faster. This is a valuation distinction, not a forecast of a subsequent price path.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Apple growth expectations face downside revisions
claims.reason: FY 2020 EPS grew about 10.4%, below the referenced 14%, supporting the outcome direction. The archived consensus-revision path and whether the chart uses fiscal or calendar years remain unverified.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Fiscal 2020 consolidated financial statements
evidence.finding: Fiscal 2020 diluted EPS was $3.28 versus split-restated $2.97 in 2019, growth of about 10.4%, below 14%; annual revenue grew about 5.5%.

claims.next_check: Verify source-chart fiscal-year convention and archived analyst consensus revisions.

claims.claim: China shutdown disrupts multinational supply chains
claims.reason: Apple had already withdrawn its March-quarter guidance on February 17, explicitly identifying slow Chinese factory ramp-up and worldwide iPhone shortages. This confirms the supply-chain mechanism in a named multinational, separately from weak Chinese demand. It is confirmation of a publication-era explanation, not a new forecast win.
claims.direction_assessment: See independently checked outcomes and qualifications in reason.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Investor update on quarterly guidance
evidence.finding: Apple expected to miss March-quarter guidance because Chinese production restarted slowly and worldwide iPhone supply was temporarily constrained; domestic demand was a separate factor.

claims.claim: Central banks will intervene within weeks
claims.reason: The Fed cut rates March 3 and announced expanded purchases March 23. Timing and the stated crisis-liquidity mechanism fit directly. Evidence here verifies the Fed branch, not every foreign central bank.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: coming weeks and months
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: March 3 FOMC statement
evidence.finding: The Fed cut the target range by 50 basis points to 1-1.25%, explicitly citing evolving coronavirus risks.

evidence.title: Federal Reserve announces extensive new measures
evidence.finding: The Fed announced Treasury and agency MBS purchases in amounts needed to support market functioning amid the coronavirus emergency.

claims.claim: Stimulus competes with deteriorating fundamentals
claims.reason: A tug-of-war metaphor permits both price directions. Without a net forecast or explicit conditional path, virtually any volatile market would fit.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Preexisting slowing conditions amplified vulnerability
claims.reason: BEA confirms slower 2019 growth, but this does not prove the subsequent crash was inevitable absent COVID. Claims also continued to make lower readings before shutdowns.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Fourth quarter and year 2019 GDP, advance estimate
evidence.finding: Q4 real GDP grew 2.1% annualized, unchanged from Q3; imports decreased but exports increased. Consumption and business investment slowed; 2019 growth was 2.3% versus 2.9% in 2018.

evidence.title: Initial unemployment claims
evidence.publisher: US Department of Labor via FRED
evidence.finding: Latest-vintage weekly claims fell from 247,000 on December 7, 2019 to 202,000 on February 8, 2020 before the pandemic surge. Revised observations do not reproduce exactly the publication-era chart.

claims.claim: Expectations and policy explain China relative resilience
claims.reason: The claim is retrospective and explicitly not a forecast of full-year leadership. Need specified indices, currencies and policy-event attribution to verify relative performance and its causes.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Identify chart indices and return convention, then compare YTD/3/6-month returns without substituting different Chinese indices.

claims.claim: High option premiums lower purchase basis
claims.reason: A received premium lowers net basis if assigned, but a further price fall does not mechanically cause immediate exercise. Elevated premium compensates greater downside and is not free return.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Options assignment FAQ
evidence.finding: American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.

claims.claim: Mining consolidation improves capital discipline
claims.reason: Need aggregate returns on invested capital, leverage and dilution across a defined miner universe. A higher gold price can improve profits without better allocation.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Compare 2018-25 miner ROIC at constant gold/energy prices and acquisition-adjusted debt.

claims.claim: Gold royalties offer superior business structure
claims.reason: Avoiding direct mine operations trades operating risk for counterparty and contract risks. Superior requires a defined return/risk comparison.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

claims.reason: GDX gained 7.14% over three years and 55.68% over five, below SPY at both checkpoints. The general mining-discipline mechanism remains separately unresolved.

claims.claim: SGOL offers safer Swiss jurisdiction
claims.reason: The legal trust was organized in New York and London custody had already been authorized in 2019. Swiss vault exposure is not equivalent to purely Swiss legal jurisdiction. The broader ranking of safety remains subjective and custody-specific.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: June 2019 Form 10-Q
evidence.publisher: Aberdeen Standard Gold ETF Trust / SEC
evidence.finding: The trust was organized in New York. Its June 2019 amendments added London as an authorized gold-custody location and removed Swiss from the share name, before this article was published.

claims.next_check: Compare contemporaneous legal rights, custody locations, fees and redemption terms; do not equate vault location with issuer domicile.

claims.claim: Rural niche resists online retail competition
claims.reason: 2020 strong sales and e-commerce growth support the durability of the business. They do not isolate resistance to Amazon from exceptional pandemic demand for home, land and animal products.

evidence.title: Fiscal 2020 results
evidence.finding: 2020 sales increased 27.2%, comparable sales 23.1%, and net income rose to $749 million. Petsense incurred $74.1 million impairment. Q4 gross margin increased 75 basis points; dividend was raised 30% in January 2021.

claims.claim: Ten-year growth and returns remain attractive
claims.reason: The explicit decade extends to 2030. Strong first-year growth does not resolve saturation risk, the model return or S&P outperformance. Numeric model inputs occur in an uninspected image.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Expansion and competitors can dilute niche economics
claims.reason: These are contingent risk branches, including a possible acquisition, without a trigger date or probability. They should be tracked rather than counted as forecast hits.

framework_lessons: Stress the specific customer mix, not only the cycle.
assessment: The near-term risk and policy-response calls were useful. Tractor Supply's business performed better than a generic recession template suggested, while Petsense provided negative acquisition evidence. The Swiss-safety framing needs legal/custody distinctions. Long-horizon value targets remain pending or data-limited.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
No complete adjusted total-return series or original-vintage macro database was available for this review. Unverified outcomes are explicitly unscored.
